parts.name: assessment-gap
parts.prose: APR-CONF-001 is core-only behaviour: a single-form API handed a stream must report APR_STREAM_REQUIRES_ITERATION and must not select a record by position. APR-CONF-005 and APR-CONF-012, that an implementation not claiming core+attestations never reports a document as verified and should say attestations are present but unchecked, are about what it displays. The harness scores acceptance, not wording.
